tools.reuse: Public BC/export core; public validate_teacher currently supports explicit 512/256/128 Teacher, not arbitrary 2048 Teachers.

tools.entry: plan / prepare / relabel / fit / replay / cycle / export
tools.reuse: Existing historical public CLI. Do not dispatch the complete V4/691 Teacher through its old 512 or MCU312 branch.
Task-local explicit Teacher/spec/contract loader and same-domain execution adapter. A new Teacher requires a new adapter binding; do not edit this completed task.
Actual pre-action input, frozen Teacher deterministic labels, whole-episode splits, history aggregation.
One bounded BC round and same-condition validation; no final-test reselection.
Optional signed central-difference feedback matching. Process-local temporary bindings must be restored; historical weights/LR are not universal defaults.
Independent Student rollouts, train-only replay, separate validation/holdout/ONNX. Never copy historical fault-recovery exceptions into a new task.
Paired same-Plant anti-oscillation/support/recovery scoring; thresholds belong to the declared task protocol.
Complete named matrix and per-condition comparisons, never mix successful rows from different Students.
Signed response and scalar-modal additive probes; failed linearity cannot establish stability margin.
Common real-log states as a supplementary signed-response diagnostic.
Physical motion, load-bearing, geometric gap and layered torque diagnostics.
Actor mean only, fixed [1,31] to [1,6], actual/reference/boundary/reset golden inputs.
Generated C weights/runtime, host golden comparison and one electrical README; not MCU execution certification.
Bounded pauseable same-domain GUI, no-run default; read-only recorded model selection.

manual_stages.action: Bind one Teacher SHA, explicit architecture/critic metadata, parent spec, full Plant tuple, actual execution scales/timing and finite block limits.
Run or reuse SHA-matched Teacher baselines on the same Plant/initial states and protocol; read back motor/NET/contact components.
Split whole episodes into training/validation/final test; label actual pre-action inputs, retain original and all previous train-only Student replays.
Run one bounded deterministic-mean BC round; fresh BC Adam, fixed std, optional separately declared signed-response loss.
Evaluate independent Student on the same complete validation matrix; compare support, real high-frequency q/dq, recovery and low-speed response.
If authorized and useful, collect separate train-only Student trajectories, query frozen Teacher and return to stage03. Do not relabel validation/test trajectories as training.
Rank same-matrix closed-loop fidelity, retain earlier candidates when appropriate; freeze checkpoint SHA before final holdout.
Run the frozen model on untouched conditions; record any fidelity gap without changing the chosen model or feeding test results into BC.
Export deterministic ONNX, compare PyTorch/ONNX/C on fixed goldens, then validate actual ONNX in independent closed loop.
Finalize one electrical README and checksums after all content edits, reconcile all finite blocks and state NOT_RUN/hardware limits.
